title: AstaBrief 8B
description: Serve AstaBrief 8B on Runpod Serverless with vLLM. An 8B open model for cited research reports runs on a single mid-range GPU, a natural fit for Runpod Serverless or on-demand Pods. Allen AI releases draw researchers who want to inspect and fine-tune on open training data, which pulls fine-tuning workloads too. Day-one availability gives Runpod a quick template win while attention is high.
